name: Character Catalog — filter by element and search for Gojo
description: Verify that navigating to the Character Catalog, filtering by element and searching for Gojo displays matching character cards with proper badges.

planSteps.description: Click the Personagens (Characters) navigation link in the sidebar
Type 'Gojo' into the search input box
Verify the character grid updates to display Satoru Gojo character cards with their epithet and element badges, and the filter counter updates
